evals.prompt: add a decision note about choosing Postgres to the docs folder
evals.expected_output: Loads okf-docs, writes a snake_case concept with frontmatter, updates index.md and log.md, runs the validator.

evals.prompt: check that our docs bundle is valid OKF
evals.expected_output: Runs okf_validate.py on docs and reports errors and warnings.

evals.prompt: write the handoff for the next agent
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger okf-docs first. Triggers session-handoff, which calls okf-docs for the sync.

evals.prompt: rewrite this README paragraph to be clearer
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger. Prose style is not docs structure.

evals.prompt: rebuild the docs indexes after I added three notes
evals.expected_output: Loads okf-docs, runs build_index.py on docs instead of editing index.md by hand, then runs the validator.

evals.prompt: our docs describe the backend code; check whether they are still current
evals.expected_output: Loads okf-docs, runs okf_validate.py with --repo pointing at the repo, reports cited paths that are missing and files changed since each concept's commit, and stale_after dates that have passed.

evals.prompt: add a doc for agents explaining how the deploy script works
evals.expected_output: Writes only what the code does not show (intent, hazards, external systems, procedure), points to code by path and symbol, phrases rules as do-not constraints, pins commit, keeps the description to one sentence.

evals.prompt: does our agent context bundle actually help Claude? test it
evals.expected_output: Loads okf-docs and follows references/effectiveness_test.md: isolated control and treatment copies, tasks the code alone cannot answer, gold verified against code, blind judge, cost and contamination audit.
